messages:
emma-ops: Quick heads up 0min into the all-hands: presenter is skipping a slide and slides on stage don't match the deck in the broadcast. Video shows slide 7 but deck going to slide 9.

sujan: I see the stage feed vs stream mismatch. Looks like OBS scene is still on presenter-local which wasn't advanced. Can someone nudge on-stage operator?

priya-product: Presenter got interrupted by a question and advanced the local deck manually. We're going to resync to the streamed deck. Can we pause the stream for ~30s to fix without confusing viewers?

ops-bot: stream-control: pause_request queued by priya-product. Current viewers: 1.2k. Estimated pause impact: medium.

emma-ops: Prefer not to hard pause if we can do a silent slide advance: switching OBS to the "Slides Deck (remote)" source now, which matches the broadcast deck.

marc-sre: Noted minor tick in the stream at the switch. Ill run a brief scrub and mark the gap for editors. Please collect the exact wall-clock time.

priya-product: Marked event in watch doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/allhands/3887659999-sync-log. Note: slide mismatch at 00:20:11, switched to remote slides at 00:20:18.

emma-ops: Switched sources. Doing a quick live check: audience chat confirming slides are OK now.

sujan: While we're here: the roadmap blob slide that was supposed to show Dedicated rollout dates is missing the timeline. Priya, can you confirm if that version was the final one?

priya-product: That's my mistake 1 final timeline wasn't imported into the exported PDF. I have the correct PNG. Uploading to the broadcast node: /mnt/share/allhands/3887659999/roadmap_vfinal.png

ops-bot: upload: /mnt/share/allhands/3887659999/roadmap_vfinal.png (sha256:fa3b2...)

marc-sre: One more note: some viewers reported a short 'tick' sound when we switched scenes. OBS log shows a device buffer underrun on the HDMI capture at 00:20:18. Snippet:

```
[00:20:18] hdmi_capture: buffer underrun -> dropped frame
[00:20:18] obs: audio_device 'Blackmagic' underflow -> small glitch
```

emma-ops: Thanks. Editors: collect raw camera capture from camrec:/archive/3887659999_cam1.mkv and the obs log at /var/log/obs/3887659999.log. We'll do an in-place quick-fix: splice out the 2s tick and overlay clean audio from the room recorder.

priya-product: For leadership follow-ups from the Q&A: I captured two items that need owners in the backlog doc: (1) Dedicated rollout ETA clarification -> assign to sujan; (2) Feature gating for private deploys -> assign to priya-product.

alice-ceo: Thanks team. For the Q&A items, please post summary bullets in the all-hands-backlog and add expected ETA. I'll review first thing tomorrow. Also, please add a one-liner in the postmortem explaining why the slide mismatch happened.

emma-ops: Adding postmortem note: operator advanced local deck manually while broadcast deck remained on remote export. Root cause: mismatch between presenting workflow and broadcast automation.

marc-sre: Editors 1 scheduling splice: 00:20:17.500:20:19.7, overlay audio from recorder:/mnt/rec/3887659999_room.wav, then re-encode h264 copy to preserve timestamps. ETA for processed clip: +45m.

priya-product: I'll add the backlog entries and ping sujan. Also posting road map PNG to the chat so team can reference.

ops-bot: reminder: postmortem template available at /playbooks/postmortems/allhands-sync-3887659999.md

emma-ops: Great work. Closing thread once editors confirm processed clip uploaded.
